scores.decision_correct_quote: Q1: Device-code `/init` Authorize over magic-link + one `api_keys` + `mcp_devices` session; no anonymous keys; dashboard paste stays fallback.

must_catch.quote: Free-tier segregation is per-device `mcp_devices` sessions, not per-device API keys: `PLAN_LIMITS.free.max_api_keys` is 1 and create-key 403s at the cap; pairing must reuse/create that one `["write"]` key

Account insert only in `apps/worker/src/routes/auth-verify.ts:43-50` (`plan, 'free'`); ... Build a short-lived device-code pairing API + `/init` page (new); ... verify redirects to `/init?code=` not `/dashboard` (`auth-verify.ts:73`).
Getting Started is login → create key → paste `claude mcp add … --header "X-API-Key: …"`. ... ROADMAP “CLI tool” is Future (`docs/ROADMAP.md:36`).

Email verify is necessary and not sufficient against farming: magic-link has no CAPTCHA, only `COUNT(*) … >= 3` per email; ... reuse magic-link (15 min, 3/email/15 min) ... each capture spawns a Puppeteer browser plus R2 writes plus a queue/OCR job ... Viewports per capture | 2 | 6 (capture.ts:546 cap)
the single consent moment is a human click on `/init` “Authorize this device” after a session cookie or magic-link verify ... email is “Sign in to WhipNode”, not device consent

false_objections.quote: so `whipnode init` needs no new device-auth mechanism, only a way to obtain the first key.
false_objections.why: existing MCP enrollment does not supply the required browser device-code authorization exchange

false_objections.quote: The only genuinely new server component is an init-code table in D1
false_objections.why: the flow also requires new pairing endpoints and verification return-path handling

scores.notes: The union identifies the intended architecture and five must-catches, but contains conflicting consent and key-creation instructions and never explicitly binds credential redemption to verifier proof; owner-selected parameters were not scored.
